title: Glycemia history graph - no detailed view possible back in the past
symptom: In the glycemia history graph view, full detail history is only available for 30 days back, and each day further back the detailed view becomes almost twice as short with no possibility to extend.
fix: The issue was fixed in the Nov 5th nightly release (2022.11.05). Users confirmed that installing this release resolved the problem.
evidence_quote: I was able to replicate this issue when it was logged but installing the Nov 5th nightly the problem has gone away so it looks fixed to me - thank you!
